description: History of versions installed on this device, oldest first. Inputs: the stored history, the current installed version and an optional cap (default 100). The current version (normalized: AppVersion description) is appended only when it differs from the last entry; a downgrade is a change and is appended too. The oldest entries are dropped so the result never exceeds the cap (minimum 1). An invalid current version fails open: the history is returned unchanged except for the cap. Stored entries are never rewritten.

cases.name: same version spelled differently is not appended
an older entry equal to current does not stop the append
invalid current version leaves history unchanged
cap applies even without a change
